extractedText: NNxCode Team2026-02-13•6 min readAnthropic Hits $380B Valuation: $30B Funding, Super Bowl Ads, and Claude Code's $2.5B Revenue February 13, 2026 — In the span of one week, Anthropic pulled off a triple play that fundamentally shifted the AI industry landscape: a $30 billion funding round at a $380 billion valuation, a viral Super Bowl ad campaign that publicly attacked OpenAI's ad strategy, and the revelation that Claude Code's revenue has doubled to $2.5 billion annualized since January 1. This guide breaks down each milestone and what it means for developers, investors, and the AI industry. The $30B Series G: Second-Largest Tech Raise Ever On February 12, 2026, Anthropic closed the second-largest private funding round in tech history at $30 billion—trailing only OpenAI's $40B+ raise. Shaw VenturesParticipantDragoneerParticipantFounders FundParticipant (Peter Thiel)ICONIQParticipantMGXParticipant Notable: Microsoft and Nvidia participating in Anthropic's round while both also invest in OpenAI signals that even strategic backers are hedging their bets in the AI race. Valuation Context CompanyValuationStatusOpenAI~$400B+PrivateAnthropic$380BPrivateSpaceX~$350BPrivateStripe~$90BPrivate Anthropic is now in the same tier as OpenAI and SpaceX—a remarkable trajectory for a company founded just four years ago by former OpenAI researchers. Claude Code's Explosive Growth Perhaps the most significant number in Anthropic's announcement: Claude Code's run-rate revenue has reached $2.5 billion, having more than doubled since January 1, 2026. Revenue Breakdown MetricFigureCompany annualized revenue$14 billionClaude Code annualized revenue$2.5 billionClaude Code % of total~18%Claude Code growth2x+ since Jan 1, 2026Business subscriptions growth4x since start of yearEnterprise share>50% of Claude Code revenue Why Claude Code Is Growing So Fast Claude Code has become the preferred terminal-based AI coding agent for professional developers. Key advantages: 200K token context window — Handles massive codebases in a single session Agentic workflow — Autonomously navigates repos, runs tests, creates PRs Terminal-native — Lives where developers already work, no IDE lock-in 1M token extended context — Claude Opus 4.6's extended thinking for complex tasks The quadrupling of business subscriptions suggests that enterprises are standardizing on Claude Code for their development teams—a powerful moat. Revenue Growth Timeline PeriodAnnualized RevenueGrowth2023~$100M—2024~$1B~10x2025~$10B~10xFeb 2026$14B10x+ annualized pace Three consecutive years of 10x annual growth is unprecedented for an AI company at this scale. The Super Bowl Ad Campaign What Happened During Super Bowl LX (February 9, 2026), Anthropic aired multiple satirical ads that became the talk of the game. The campaign, "A Time and a Place," was timed to coincide with OpenAI's announcement of ads in ChatGPT. The Ads Each ad followed the same format: a person asking an AI chatbot for help with something personal, only for the chatbot to pivot mid-conversation to selling a product. "Betrayal" (feat. Dr. Dre soundtrack) A man asks a chatbot for advice on talking to his mom The chatbot responds with genuine advice... then smoothly transitions to promoting "Golden Encounters," a fictional cougar-dating site Screen flashes: "BETRAYAL" "Treachery" Someone asks for fitness advice The chatbot recommends exercises... then pivots to selling height-boosting insoles Text: "Ads are coming to AI. But not to Claude." The Results MetricAnthropic/ClaudeChatGPTGeminiDAU increase+11%+2.7%+1.4%App Store rank#41 → #7——Site visits+6.5%—— Claude achieved its highest App Store ranking ever (#7), and the 11% DAU jump was the largest post-Super Bowl boost among any AI company. Sam Altman's Response OpenAI CEO Sam Altman fired back publicly, calling the Anthropic ads "deceptive" and "clearly dishonest." The public spat escalated into a broader debate about: Whether AI chatbots should show ads at all Whether Anthropic's critique was fair given its own $200/month pricing Who gets to define the "ethical" AI business model The drama generated massive free media coverage for both companies. The Bigger Picture: Two Competing AI Business Models The ChatGPT ads + Anthropic Super Bowl response crystallized the two dominant AI business models: Model A: OpenAI's Approach Free tier with ads → $8 Go (with ads) → $20 Plus (no ads) → $200 Pro Maximize user base, monetize through ads + subscriptions Similar to Google's search model Revenue: Broad-based, consumer + enterprise Model B: Anthropic's Approach No ads, ever → Subscription tiers + API usage Position as the "premium, trustworthy" alternative Similar
